## 检查清单 / Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` 通过 / passes
- [ ] `npm test` 通过 / passes
- [ ] 能从大厅开局，走几步后各端状态保持同步 / The game starts from the lobby and stays in sync after a few moves
- [ ] 新的界面文字 / 规则说明在 `zh` 和 `en` 里都有 / New UI strings / rules text exist in both `zh` and `en`
- [ ] 隐藏信息（手牌、身份）经过 `playerView` / Hidden information (hands, roles) goes through `playerView`
- [ ] 视觉改动附了截图（改了布局的话电脑和手机都要）/ Screenshots attached for visual changes (desktop and phone if layout changed)
